name: models3d_relief
description: Hi3D Relief: a depth map of one image, PNG, near is bright. An image, not a mesh: for a GLB use `models3d_generate`. Takes ~5 min. Upload external images first.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

removeBackground.description: Cut the subject from its background first. Default true.
